coordinates: PDF points, origin top-left, y grows downward. Underscore run or drawn rule: its x extent, from 14 pt above the line to 1.5 pt under it. Cell or box: its drawn edges. Tick box: the printed square. Picture pages: the picture's pixels through the page's drawing matrix.

signing.kind: Canadian-style private placement subscription for common stock: the subscriber initials the completion checklist (page 1), completes and signs the face page (pages 3-4: name, securities, amount, signature, title, residential address, contact, disclosed principal, registration); the corporation accepts with date and signature on page 19; depending on residence the subscriber completes Schedule B (Canadian accredited investor ticks, pages 21-26) with Exhibit I for individuals under (j), (k), (l) (initials, name, signature, date; the salesperson completes section 5, pages 27-28), Schedule C (non-Canadian/non-US, page 31) or Schedule D (US accredited investor initial lines, place and date, individual or entity signature, pages 32-34).
